column3: This world isn't big enough for the two of us! ([OUR_NAME] declares war!)
We have suffered your insolence for long enough! ([OUR_NAME] declares war!)
Prepare to meet your doom! ([OUR_NAME] declares war!)
Now you shall pay for your many insults to the [OUR_EMPIRE]! ([OUR_NAME] declares war!)
The time for talking is over, [CT_NAME]! We shall shall settle this on the field of battle! ([OUR_NAME] declares war!)
Soon my numberless minions shall destroy you all! ([OUR_NAME] declares war!)
Time to die, [CT_NAME]. ([OUR_NAME] declares war!)
Fool! Now we shall destroy you! ([OUR_NAME] declares war!)
I suppose you realize, this means war. ([OUR_NAME] declares war!)
Mighty [OUR_EMPIRE] has had enough of your treachery and deceit! Now you must pay! ([OUR_NAME] declares war!)
Greetings! I am [OUR_NAME] of the [OUR_EMPIRE]. I hope that our two great peoples can live together in peace.
Welcome, [CT_NAME]! I cannot tell a lie: I'm darned glad to meet you!
Greetings, [CT_NAME]! It is an honor to meet you! May the heavens bestow upon you an empire only slightly less glorious than mine!
I am pleased to meet you, [CT_NAME]! Let us each slaughter fifty thousand slaves to celebrate this auspicious occasion.

Greetings, honorable [CT_NAME]. Let us hope that there will always be peace and friendship between [OUR_EMPIRE] and [CT_CIV_SHORT] - for that is all that stands between you and immediate annihilation.
Greetings, [CT_NAME]. It is a pleasure to meet you. Here: have a copy of my little red book. You might learn something.
Surely the gods have smiled upon you, [CT_NAME] - for they have led you to me!
Welcome to my palace, [CT_NAME]. I'm [OUR_NAME], the wise and really quite beautiful leader of mighty [OUR_CIV_SHORT]. Let there be peace between us or we'll kill you.
Good day to you, [CT_NAME]. We are [OUR_NAME], ruler of [OUR_CIV_SHORT]. Please do not hesitate to call upon us if you need assistance - God commands us give aid and comfort to our inferiors...
Welcome! I am [OUR_NAME], absolute monarch of mighty [OUR_CIV_SHORT] and indisputably the handsomest and best-dressed ruler in the entire history of the universe. Wouldn't you agree?
Greetings. I'm [OUR_NAME], Emperor, Marshal, and First Citizen of [OUR_CIV_SHORT]. You can call me "Little Corporal," but then I'll have to kill you.
[OUR_CIV_SHORT] the great and its superior people greet you. I, [OUR_NAME], desire peace with all my neighbors - even with your puny culture.
Greetings, [CT_NAME]! I am [OUR_NAME], ruler of the warlike [OUR_EMPIRE]! Let us join together and crush the world's armies beneath our sandals! It'll be way cool!
The [OUR_EMPIRE] welcomes the glorious [CT_CIV_ADJ] people and their leader, [CT_NAME]. You play ceremonial ball with us, we'll play ceremonial ball with you.
May peace and happiness go with you always, [CT_NAME]. I am [OUR_NAME] of [OUR_CIV_SHORT].
Welcome to my humble home, [CT_NAME]. [OUR_CIV_SHORT] desires peace with all of her neighbors - even the really annoying ones like yours.
Welcome, [CT_NAME]! May your empire flourish and grow for as long as it remains useful to us! I mean that sincerely.
Welcome, [CT_NAME]. I, [OUR_NAME], humble ruler of [OUR_CIV_SHORT], offer my hand to you in friendship.
Welcome, oh leader of the [CT_EMPIRE]. My horde can beat your horde any day of the week. Shall we be friends or enemies?
The mighty [OUR_EMPIRE] greets you. Let us work together to achieve the total destruction of our foes, and only THEN betray and rend each other like the rabid dogs we truly are!
Greetings, oh wise ruler of the [CT_CIV_ADJ] peoples! [OUR_CIV_SHORT] is strong - shall we count you among our friends, or among our enemies?
Welcome to [OUR_CIV_SHORT], [CT_NAME]. Care for some salad? I made it myself.
